resources.string: I-SandFly Pro ibhala iskripthi ngokwencazelo yalokho okufanele sikwenze, futhi isihlole efonini. Vula i-app iskripthi esenzelwe yona, bese usebenzisa umyalo othi Yakha iskripthi nge-SandFly Pro, noma uwukhethe ku-Amasethingi, Iziskripthi. Iskripthi sivuleka ku-Umakhi weskripthi ukuze usamukele, usishintshe noma usilahle. Ukwakha iskripthi kusebenzisa ingxenye enkulu kakhulu yomkhawulo wokusetshenziswa wenyanga kunomsebenzi we-ejenti.

Yenza iskripthi ngaphandle kwekhodi: imithetho ebiza izinto ngamalebula amasha, ezifihlayo noma ezithulisayo, eshintsha lokho i-SandFly ekushoyo ngazo, ezifunda njengento eyodwa noma ezengeza izenzo, kanye nezilawuli zokufunda ezintsha, imiyalo nezinto eziqalisayo. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Iziskripthi, Iskripthi esisha. Qopha isenzo siqopha isenzo somthetho ngenkathi usenza ku-app.

Umyalo othi Rekhoda imakhro uqopha izinyathelo zemakhro entsha ngenkathi uzenza: ukucindezela, ukuskrola, umbhalo othayiphiwe, ama-app avuliwe nemiyalo. Ukuze uyeke, sebenzisa futhi u-Rekhoda imakhro. Ukuze uqophe izinyathelo emakhrweni ekhona, khetha u-Rekhoda izinyathelo esikrinini sayo.

Imakhro ingakhawulelwa ukuthi isebenze ku-app eyodwa kuphela. Uma u-Bonisa ku-Izenzo uvuliwe, imakhro isemenyu ye-Izenzo yento ngayinye ku-app yayo. Ukuze usebenzise imakhro esikrinini sasekhaya, khetha u-Engeza esikrinini sasekhaya esikrinini semakhro. Amamakhro anezinyathelo ezintsha, njengokuthi Thepha endaweni, Thinta futhi ubambe into, Setha ivolumu, Setha isibali sikhathi, Shaya kanye ne-Thumela umlayezo.

Ukuthepha okukodwa kuya kokuthathu ngeminwe emi-2, emi-3 noma emi-4, bese kuswayiphwa, njengokuthi Thepha kabili, bese uswayiphela phezulu ngeminwe emi-2. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Thepha, bese uswayipha. Abanawo umyalo ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Ukunyakaza kwe-engeli ngeminwe emi-2, njengokuthi Swayiphela phezulu bese kwesokudla ngeminwe emi-2. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, i-engeli yeminwe emi-2. Kudinga u-Phatha ukuswayipha ngeminwe emibili ku-SandFly.

Ukuswayipha ngomunwe owodwa ezinhlangothini ezintathu ngokuswayipha okukodwa, njengokuthi Swayiphela ngakwesokudla, phezulu, bese kwesokudla. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Ukuswayipha kwezingxenye ezintathu.

Ukuswayipha okubili ngomunwe owodwa, umunwe uphakanyiswa phakathi kwakho, njengokuthi Swayiphela ngakwesokudla, phakamisa, bese uswayiphela phezulu. Ukuze ukuvule, iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Isikhathi phakathi kokuswayipha kokuqala nokwesibili.
Nyakazisa ifoni, noma uthephe ingemuva lefoni kane, ukuze uqalise umyalo. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Ukunyakazisa, noma Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Ukuthepha ngemuva.

Ngenkathi ukuthinta kukhiyiwe, ukuthinta isikrini akwenzi lutho. Ukuze uvule, sebenzisa umyalo othi Khiya noma vula ukuthinta, noma ucindezele bobabili okhiye bevolumu. Ukuze ukhiye ukuthinta ngokuzenzakalelayo, iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukuthinta, Khiya ukuthinta ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Kuma-app owakhethayo, ukusebenzisa into kuyithepha esikrinini. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukuthinta, Ukuthepha kabili kuthepha isikrini.
Ima entweni yokugcina ngaphambi kokubuyela ekuqaleni

Uma u-Buyela ekuqaleni uvuliwe, ukuswayipha kokuqala okudlula into yokugcina kuma lapho ngomsindo wokuphela, futhi ukuswayipha okulandelayo kubuyela ekuqaleni. Kuvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, ku-Amasethingi, Ukuzulazula. U-Buyela ekuqaleni ezilawulini zokufunda usesikrinini esifanayo.
Ingxenye ngayinye yombhalo nesimo ngasinye ngaphakathi kwento kuthola ukugxila kwakho. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukuzulazula, Gxila embhalweni ongaphakathi kwezinto ngokwehlukana.

Nge-Sho kuphela ukugxila okuhanjiswe ngumsebenzisi, i-SandFly ikhuluma kuphela ukugxila okuhambisayo, kuwo wonke ama-app noma kuma-app owakhethayo. I-Amakhibhodi anenkulumo yawo ivala inkulumo yokhiye nombhalo othayiphiwe ngenkathi kuboniswa ikhibhodi oyikhethile. Iya ku-Amasethingi, I-Verbosity.
Iqoqa umbhalo wayo yonke into engemva kwento egxilisiwe ngaphandle kwenkulumo, iskrola endleleni. Ekugcineni, maka imibhalo okufanele ikopishwe. Umyalo use-Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Ukuhlela umbhalo.
Izilawuli zokufunda zamathebula nemiyalo kuhamba phakathi kwamaseli egridi, futhi izenzo zeseli zihlanganisa u-Hlela iseli no-Faka ifomula.

Hamba uye entweni engakwesokunxele no-Hamba uye entweni engakwesokudla, Sebenzisa inkinobho yokuqinisekisa no-Sebenzisa inkinobho yokukhansela, Funda okuvela entweni egxilisiwe ngesilawuli sokufunda, Phinda umshwana okhulunyiwe wokugcina kancane, Funda inkambu yombhalo, Inani lezinhlamvu, Yabelana ngesithombe sento egxilisiwe, Yabelana ngesithombe-skrini, Isilawuli sokufunda sokuqala kanye no-Ukunyakaza kwale app. Yabela imiyalo ku-Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza noma Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi.

Indlela yokufaka yamakhibhodi angokoqobo, engenabo okhiye esikrinini. Okhiye ababanjiwe bathayipha uhlamvu lwe-Alt noma uhlamvu olukhulu, okhiye abacindezelwe kabili bangathayipha ezinye izinhlamvu, futhi u-Sesha i-emoji no-Khetha uphawu bathayipha ama-emoji nezimpawu. Ukuze uyivule, iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukuthayipha, Ikhibhodi engokoqobo, Ikhibhodi ye-SandFly.

I-Imephu yokhiye yefoni enekhibhodi ne-Imephu yokhiye abalodwa yefoni enekhibhodi ezamafoni anekhibhodi eyakhelwe ngaphakathi, njenge-Unihertz Titan, i-BlackBerry KEY2 ne-Zinwa Q25. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi, Khetha ukhiye wemephu.
Gcina okhiye becindezelwe ngemva kokubambezela kokuthinta nokubamba
Ekupheleni kokubambezela, i-SandFly icindezela ukhiye futhi idlulisele okusele kokuthinta kukhibhodi, njengokhiye wokususa ophindaphindayo. Iya ku-Amasethingi, Ukuthayipha.

Thayipha amaseli e-braille esikrinini ukuze uqalise imiyalo, usesha i-app, noma uthole umbhalo esikrinini. Sebenzisa umyalo othi Imiyalo ye-braille. Ukuze ushintshe amaseli, iya ku-Amasethingi, I-Braille, Imiyalo ye-braille.

Izinhlamvu ze-braille ezenziwe ngezifiso zithayipha izinhlamvu noma imibhalo ngamaseli e-braille owakhethayo. U-Buyekeza ukuma kwamachashazi ngenkathi uthayipha uhambisa amachashazi abheke lapho iminwe yakho ithinta khona, futhi uvuliwe ngokuzenzakalelayo. Kokubili kuku-Amasethingi, I-Braille, Ikhibhodi ye-Braille. Amathebula e-braille esi-Persian nesi-Romanian ayatholakala.

Isilinganisi somsindo manje sese-Amasethingi, Inkulumo, Imiphumela yezwi, no-Ukucindezelwa kwe-bass, Ukucindezelwa kwezwi no-Ukucindezelwa kwe-treble, kanye nokusetha ngaphambilini okuthi I-bass ejulile.

Ishiya izimpawu zokuloba nezimpawu ngaphandle kwenkulumo. Ukuze ugcine izimpawu ezifana nokuhlanganisa, ukususa nezimpawu zemali kanye nezinombolo, vula u-Sho izimpawu eziguqula incazelo. Iya ku-Amasethingi, I-Verbosity, Khuluma izimpawu zokuloba nezimpawu.

I-SandFly isho ileveli yebhethri njalo emaphesentini angu-5 noma angu-10, noma njalo emizuzwini engu-15, 30 noma 60. Iya ku-Amasethingi, I-Verbosity, Ileveli yebhethri. U-Memezela ubude bekholi no-Faka imizuzwana esikhathini nabo baku-Amasethingi, I-Verbosity.

U-Bonisa izaziso ezintsha kuqala, ngaphandle kwamaqembu ubonisa isaziso ngasinye njengento yaso. U-Ungafaki izidlali zemidiya ohlwini lwezaziso ushiya ngaphandle izaziso zezidlali zemidiya. Kokubili kuku-Amasethingi, Izaziso.

Okuthi I-SandFly iphatha konke ukucindezelwa kokhiye bevolumu, Fihla iphaneli yevolumu kanye no-Shintsha ivolumu yenkulumo ngaphandle kokumemezela ngenkathi ikhuluma kuku-Amasethingi, Okhiye bevolumu. Nge-Shizuku, izinqamuleli zokhiye bevolumu zisebenza nalapho isikrini sivaliwe.
